title: kate-ui: accept true for a profile line
summary: profile_is_on is true for 1 and for true. Any other value is false. write_sample calls it. The test goes in the existing profile tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

definitions.definition:
#[cfg_attr(not(any(test, target_os = "macos")), allow(dead_code))]
fn profile_is_on(value: Option<&std::ffi::OsStr>) -> bool

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: profile.rs has one test module named tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Add profile_is_on next to sample_json. Put this attribute on it: #[cfg_attr(not(any(test, target_os = "macos")), allow(dead_code))]. write_sample is macOS-only, so Linux needs that attribute. The body is one expression: value.is_some_and(|value| value == std::ffi::OsStr::new("1") || value == std::ffi::OsStr::new("true")). Do not add yes, on, or false. Do not nest an if inside an if. Do not write two if arms that return the same value. Combine them with ||. That is clippy::if_same_then_else. write_sample calls profile_is_on on std::env::var_os("KATEM5_PROFILE").as_deref(). Do not touch sample_json. The existing test frame_sample_json_uses_field_names stays green. Do not rewrite its assertions. The test profile_is_on_for_one_and_true checks Some of 1 is true. Some of true is true. Some of yes is false. Some of 0 is false. None is false. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines. Stay inside this one behavior. Do not add a second case for coherence. Run the full test module named in the commands, not only the new test.

regression_tests.name: profile::tests::profile_is_on_for_one_and_true
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because profile_is_on does not exist. After the change 1 is true and true is true. yes, 0, and None are false.
